segments.source: The following example transcodes the UTF-8 representation of the string `"Fermata 𝄐"` into UTF-32.
segments.normalizedSource: The following example transcodes the UTF-8 representation of the string `"Fermata 𝄐"` into UTF-32.
segments.contextAfter:
```swift
let fermata = "Fermata 𝄐"
let bytes = fermata.utf8
print(Array(bytes))
// Prints "[70, 101, 114, 109, 97, 116, 97, 32, 240, 157, 132, 144]"

var codeUnits: [UTF32.CodeUnit] = []
let sink = { codeUnits.append($0) }
transcode(bytes.makeIterator(), from: UTF8.self, to: UTF32.self,
          stoppingOnError: false, into: sink)
print(codeUnits)
// Prints "[70, 101, 114, 109, 97, 116, 97, 32, 119056]"
```
